title: Breast Cancer Awareness Workshop – KidZania Kuwait
summary: A meaningful breast cancer awareness initiative brought together female employees of KidZania, Tekzone and Quest, reinforcing the importance of early detection, informed healthcare decisions and a proactive approach to women's health.
description:
Organised as part of the Pinktober breast cancer awareness initiative, the workshop provided an opportunity to engage directly with women working across KidZania, Tekzone and Quest.

The session explored breast cancer risk factors, the importance of recognising potential warning signs, and the role of timely medical consultation and appropriate screening. Through an accessible educational presentation, the programme encouraged participants to become more informed and confident about taking care of their health.

The gathering reflected a valuable commitment by the participating organisations to employee well-being and to spreading awareness beyond the clinical setting.

title: Al Ansari Exchange – Pink October Breast Cancer Awareness
organizer: Al Ansari Exchange – Employee Wellbeing Initiative
summary: As part of its Pink October 2026 Employee Wellbeing initiative, Al Ansari Exchange organised a breast cancer awareness programme, bringing employees together to promote early detection, preventive healthcare and greater understanding of breast health.
description:
In recognition of Breast Cancer Awareness Month, Al Ansari Exchange organised a special Pink October awareness programme as part of its commitment to employee wellbeing and preventive healthcare.

The session provided an opportunity to strengthen awareness of breast cancer, emphasising the importance of recognising potential warning signs, seeking timely medical advice and making informed decisions about screening and healthcare.

An interactive question-and-answer session encouraged meaningful engagement, allowing participants to discuss concerns and gain a better understanding of breast health and early detection.

The initiative reflected Al Ansari Exchange's commitment to creating a health-conscious workplace and empowering employees with knowledge that can positively influence their families and wider communities.

Special appreciation is extended to Mr. Sreejith Mohandas, Mr. Mohammed Asadullah and the organising team for supporting this meaningful initiative.

title: Pinoy Arabia – Fight With Might, Shine Your Light
organizer: Pinoy Arabia, in collaboration with Kabayan Cancer Support Group
summary: A meaningful cancer awareness forum held during Pinoy Arabia's 12th Anniversary Barrio Fiesta 2026, promoting early detection, preventive healthcare and community support. The celebrations were graced by H.E. Jose Cabrera III, Philippine Ambassador to Kuwait.
description:
As part of its 12th Anniversary Barrio Fiesta celebrations, Pinoy Arabia hosted 'Fight With Might, Shine Your Light', a dedicated cancer awareness forum in collaboration with the Kabayan Cancer Support Group.

The session, 'Life is Precious - Let's Take Care of It', highlighted the importance of cancer awareness, timely medical attention, early detection and informed healthcare decisions.

The occasion was further distinguished by the presence of H.E. Jose Cabrera III, Philippine Ambassador to Kuwait, who addressed the gathering during the opening celebrations.

Bringing together community members, cancer support advocates and healthcare professionals, the initiative reflected the importance of collective efforts in spreading awareness, supporting those affected by cancer and empowering individuals through knowledge.

title: Empowering Through Awareness – Kuwait Flour Mills
organizer: Marketing Department – Public Relations Unit, Kuwait Flour Mills & Bakeries Co.
venue: Meeting Room Hall, Administration Building, Shuwaikh HQ, Kuwait
summary: A meaningful breast cancer awareness seminar bringing together employees of Kuwait Flour Mills & Bakeries Co., promoting informed healthcare decisions, early detection and greater awareness of women's health.
description:
As part of its annual Breast Cancer Awareness initiative, Kuwait Flour Mills & Bakeries Co. organised a special educational seminar titled Empowering Through Awareness at its Shuwaikh headquarters.

The programme brought together women employees for an informative session addressing cancer awareness, breast cancer risk factors, early warning signs and the importance of appropriate screening and timely medical consultation.

Through an engaging presentation supported by educational visuals, the session encouraged participants to take a proactive approach to their health and share this knowledge within their families and communities.

The initiative reflected the organisation's continued commitment to employee well-being, preventive healthcare education and spreading awareness beyond the hospital setting.

title: Tamil Community Welfare Association – Breast & Cervical Cancer Awareness
organizer: Veli Naadu Vaazh Thamizhargal Nala Sangam (VV TNS Welfare Trust), Kuwait
summary: A community health awareness initiative organised by the Tamil welfare association in Kuwait, focusing on breast cancer and cervical cancer prevention, early detection and the importance of informed healthcare decisions.
description:
As part of its commitment to community welfare and women's health, the Tamil welfare association in Kuwait organised a special awareness programme addressing breast cancer and cervical cancer.

The session emphasised the importance of recognising early warning signs, understanding available screening methods, seeking timely medical advice and encouraging preventive healthcare practices.

Bringing together members of the Tamil-speaking community, the programme provided an opportunity to promote health awareness, encourage open discussions and empower individuals and families with knowledge that can support early detection and better health outcomes.

The initiative reflected the association's dedication to strengthening community wellbeing through meaningful health education and awareness.

title: ASSP Kuwait – Awareness on the Health Effects of Excessive Electronic Gadget Use
organizer: American Society of Safety Professionals (ASSP) – Kuwait Chapter
summary: An interactive health awareness programme organised by ASSP Kuwait Chapter at the Australian University of Kuwait, highlighting the physical and mental health implications of excessive electronic gadget use and encouraging healthier digital habits among professionals and their families.
description:
The American Society of Safety Professionals (ASSP) – Kuwait Chapter organised an awareness programme at the Australian University of Kuwait, focusing on the adverse effects of excessive electronic gadget use on physical and mental health.

The session explored the growing impact of prolonged screen exposure on sleep, vision, posture, musculoskeletal health, mental wellbeing and child development. Practical guidance was shared on maintaining healthy digital habits, recognising early warning signs and achieving a better balance between technology use and everyday wellbeing.

The interactive programme brought together safety professionals and their families, encouraging meaningful discussions on responsible technology use and preventive health practices.

Special appreciation is extended to Dr. Khalid Omar Hantoush, Mr. Mohamed Yusuff, Ms. Vijaya Wadhawane, Ms. Smitha Raveendran and the ASSP Kuwait organising team for their commitment to community health education and for facilitating this meaningful initiative.

title: Landmark Group Kuwait – Breast Cancer Awareness Seminar
organizer: Landmark Group Kuwait, in association with the Forum of Indian Doctors (FID) and Indian Women's Association (IWA)
summary: A breast cancer awareness initiative organised by Landmark Group Kuwait in collaboration with FID and IWA, empowering women employees with knowledge about early detection, preventive healthcare and the importance of regular screening.
description:
Landmark Group Kuwait organised a Breast Cancer Awareness Seminar in collaboration with the Forum of Indian Doctors (FID) and the Indian Women's Association (IWA), reinforcing its commitment to women's health and employee wellbeing.

The programme brought together women employees for an informative and interactive session focused on breast cancer awareness, early detection, the importance of regular screening and timely medical consultation.

The seminar marked the first batch of Landmark Group's awareness initiative, with plans to extend these valuable health education sessions to additional team members.

The collaboration reflected a shared commitment to empowering women through health education, encouraging preventive healthcare practices and promoting a supportive environment where awareness can contribute to healthier lives.

title: KANIV & Apollo Clinic Kuwait – Medical Camp and Health Awareness
organizer: KANIV Indian Welfare Community and Apollo Clinic Kuwait
venue: Apollo Clinic, Street 115, Block 1, Mahboula, Kuwait
summary: A community healthcare initiative jointly organised by KANIV Indian Welfare Community and Apollo Clinic Kuwait, combining free medical check-ups with health awareness education to encourage preventive healthcare and healthier lifestyles.
description:
KANIV Indian Welfare Community, in collaboration with Apollo Clinic Kuwait, organised a free medical check-up camp and health awareness programme to promote accessible healthcare and preventive health practices within the community.

The initiative offered medical consultations and health assessments, including blood pressure monitoring, blood sugar testing, cholesterol screening and selected kidney and liver function tests.

A dedicated health awareness session highlighted the growing importance of addressing lifestyle-related diseases, recognising health risks early and adopting healthier everyday habits.

The programme reflected the organisers' commitment to community wellbeing by bringing together medical services and health education, encouraging individuals and families to take proactive steps towards better health.

title: Kuwait Cancer Control Center – Educational Session for Nutrition Students
venue: Kuwait Cancer Control Center (KCCC) – Hospital Auditorium, Kuwait
summary: An educational awareness session for nutrition students of Kuwait Cancer Control Center, supporting professional learning and a greater understanding of multidisciplinary cancer care.
description:
Kuwait Cancer Control Center (KCCC), a specialised cancer hospital in Kuwait, hosted an educational awareness session for its nutrition students.

The programme provided an opportunity for students to broaden their understanding of cancer care and the importance of multidisciplinary collaboration in supporting patients throughout their treatment journey.

The initiative reflected KCCC's commitment to professional education, knowledge sharing and the development of future healthcare professionals.
